import math
q=math.sqrt
def mm(A,B):return[[sum(A[i][k]*B[k][j]for k in range(len(B)))for j in range(len(B[0]))]for i in range(len(A))]
def dg(A):return[[A[j][i].conjugate()for j in range(len(A))]for i in range(len(A[0]))]
def kr(A,B):return[[A[i//len(B)][j//len(B[0])]*B[i%len(B)][j%len(B[0])]for j in range(len(A[0])*len(B[0]))]for i in range(len(A)*len(B))]
def flip(E):return[[E[2*(r%2)+r//2][j]for j in range(2)]for r in range(4)]
def scalar(R,L):
 X=mm(dg(R),L);s=sum(X[i][i]for i in range(2))/2;e=max(abs(X[i][j]-(s if i==j else 0))for i in range(2)for j in range(2));return s,e
I=[[1,0],[0,1]];EC=[[1/q(2),0],[0,-1/q(2)],[0,-1/q(2)],[-1/q(2),0]];W=[[-q(3)+1j,0],[0,-2j],[1+1j*q(3),0],[0,2]];ag=(-q(3)-1j)/2;VG=[[ag*z/(2*q(2))for z in r]for r in W];VH=[[z.conjugate()for z in r]for r in VG]
for t,U in [('G',VH),('H',VG)]:
 S=flip(U);L=mm(kr(U,I),S);R=mm(kr(I,S),U);print('CFC',t,scalar(R,L))
 outer=flip(VG if t=='G' else VH);L2=mm(kr(S,I),S);R2=mm(kr(I,EC),outer);print('FCC',t,scalar(R2,L2))
